svg.title: top_wire five-stage datapath
svg.desc: Schematic of top_wire. Data flows left to right through PC, instruction ROM, IF/ID, decoder and register file, ID/EX, forwarding and operand muxes, ALU and comparator, EX/MEM, data memory and load extend, MEM/WB, and the write-back mux. Control, hazard and forwarding units sit in a band across the top. Next-PC and flush logic sit in a band at the bottom. Write-back and next PC loop back on their own lanes.

g.title: IF/ID: id_pc, id_pc_plus4, id_instr. Holds on stall, clears on flush.
ID/EX: ex_pc, ex_pc_plus4, ex_rd1, ex_rd2, ex_imm, ex_rs1, ex_rs2, ex_rd, ex_funct3, ex_AluCtrl and 8 one-bit controls. Bubbles on stall or flush.
EX/MEM: mem_alu_res, mem_rd2, mem_pc_plus4, mem_rd, mem_funct3, mem_RegWrite, mem_MemWrite, mem_MemToReg, mem_Jump. mem_MemRead is declared but never loaded.
MEM/WB: wb_alu_res, wb_load_data, wb_pc_plus4, wb_rd, wb_RegWrite, wb_MemToReg, wb_Jump.
